system.description: Three or more of your thralls within 30' crawl into one another. Test Sanity (DR18). On a success, Sustained: they become a Colossus, a single thrall that is destroyed only at 0 HP. It has 6 HP per thrall consumed (up to 36), -d2 armour, and an attack of 2d8 (reach 10'), and is commanded like a thrall. Its active ability is Sweep ◈◈: everyone in a 10' cone takes 3d6 damage. When the power ends or the Colossus drops to 0 HP, it collapses into difficult terrain 20' across.

outcomes.failure: No effect; the thralls are not consumed.
outcomes.ruin: The flesh rebels: the thralls are destroyed, and you take d6 damage.

outcomeEffects.note: three or more thralls within 30' become a Colossus (6 HP each, up to 36, -d2 armour, 2d8 reach 10', Sweep ◈◈: 3d6 in a 10' cone); delete the thralls and make the Colossus by hand
